item.title: FACT FOCUS: A look at false and misleading claims made during Trump’s first Cabinet meeting of 2026
item.description: Some of the president's boasts were off the mark.

item.title: A Line train extension to Claremont gets another push forward, with contracts for design, engineering, construction
item.description: The A Line, formerly Gold Line, takes a big step forward on its next journey: an extension of the light-rail line to Claremont.

item.title: Santa Anita consensus picks for Friday, January 30, 2026
item.description: The consensus box of Santa Anita horse racing picks comes from handicappers Bob Mieszerski, Eddie Wilson, Kevin Modesti and Mark Ratzky. Here are the picks for thoroughbred races on Friday, January 30, 2026.

item.title: LAPD won’t enforce ban on federal law enforcement officers wearing masks, chief says
item.description: LAPD Chief Jim McDonnell said the ban is “not a good public policy decision.”

item.title: A historic time capsule is revealed at Central Library’s 100th anniversary
item.description: A historic time capsule is revealed at Central Library's 100th anniversary.

item.title: Fire chiefs fault local leadership as US Senate probes Palisade fire
item.description: Veteran fire officials told U.S. senators that leadership failures and missed preparation steps contributed to the deadly Palisades Fire.

item.title: Los Angeles saw fewer homicides in 2025 than any year since 1966, new crime stats show
item.description: Chief Jim McDonnell discussed the city’s 2025 crime statistics on Thursday, Jan. 29.

item.title: Australian Open: Sabalenka’s new mentality vs. Rybakina’s resolve in final
item.description: Aryna Sabalenka is focusing more on past losses to motivate herself for her title match against Elena Rybakina. Sabalenka lost five finals in 2025, including the WTA Finals – to Rybakina. Neither player has dropped a set leading up to this rematch of the 2023 Aussie final.

item.title: Kings can’t slow Alex Tuch or solve Alex Lyon in loss to Sabres
item.description: Tuch has his fourth career hat trick and Lyon makes 37 saves as surging Buffalo stops the Kings’ three-game winning streak, 4-1. Adrian Kempe scores for the Kings, who had earned a point in six straight games.

item.title: Kara Dunn reaches milestone as USC women top No. 8 Iowa for statement win
item.description: Dunn scores 25 points and surpasses 1,500 for her career as the Trojans hand the Hawkeyes their first Big Ten loss of the season, 81-69. Jazzy Davidson adds 21 points and eight assists, and Londynn Jones has 17 points.
